report_identity.report_title: 新华文轩出版传媒股份有限公司2025年度报告
report_identity.unit: RMB yuan unless noted; five-year summary table is RMB 10,000

business_overview.one_sentence: 新华文轩是四川省出版发行一体化企业，主营出版、教材教辅与一般图书发行、阅读服务、教育服务和供应链服务。

segments.item: 出版分部主营业务收入
segments.business_substance: 图书、报刊、音像及数字产品出版，印刷服务及物资供应

segments.item: 发行分部主营业务收入
segments.business_substance: 教材教辅、一般图书、教育信息化及其他发行服务

business_overview.revenue_model: 以教材教辅出版发行、一般图书出版发行、线下书店和线上渠道、教育信息化项目与供应链服务取得收入。
business_notes: 2025年收入下降主要受教育服务市场环境、教材教辅及学生读物销量下降影响。
公司是四川省唯一具备开展中小学教科书发行业务资质的企业。

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Operating cash flow has covered parent net profit over the last three years, but 2025 profit includes large interest income, investment income, fair value gain and asset disposal gain. Publishing and education-service demand is under pressure, so distributable cash profit needs a haircut after removing financing/investment returns tied to detachable assets.

evidence.source: consolidated cash flow statement, text lines 4406-4446

gaps: The company website full annual report was used as primary local filing because the SSE static PDF returned an anti-bot HTML challenge in this environment.
The annual report does not fully split each bank deposit by maturity beyond the disclosed over-three-month and no-planned-withdrawal categories.
Other equity instrument investment liquidity was not fully disclosed by security; haircut is conservative in the owner earnback analysis.
